plain: To set apart by showing opposite qualities.

webster.text: To distinguish not merely by differential, but by opposite qualities.

example.quote: He, in another place, contradistinguishes it as a government of laws, in opposition to others which he denominates a government of men.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
